dataset.name: IMDb movie reviews (Maas et al., 2011), aclImdb
dataset.source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/stanfordnlp/imdb (official Hugging Face distribution of the aclImdb dataset, Maas et al. 2011)
dataset.license_note: Published by the authors for research use. Reviews are user written movie reviews with binary sentiment labels from star ratings.
dataset.sampling: seed 42, 2000 per class from the 25,000 train reviews, 500 per class from the 25,000 test reviews, official train and test splits kept separate

summarizer_demo.summary: The point is that Vera and her family are symbols for all of Soviet life. This was life in the Soviet Union for most people.
summarizer_demo.note: One example from the test set. Compression is counted, not a time saving claim. No analyst time was measured.

removed_claims: No sentiment to sales correlation is reported. No BERT, no T5. The summarizer is TF-IDF graph TextRank and is described as such.
